svg.desc: Isabela LaFleur — Chemical & Biomolecular Engineering / Scientific Computing • Biosecurity. STEM researcher and developer experienced in ML, automation, and scientific data pipelines, with projects spanning materials science, clinical imaging workflows, and women's health analytics. Molecule of the Month: Hantavirus (July 2026).
